scope: Every frame of actual v8 Film stateAt; actual GLB bounds expanded by an upper bound on displayed native displacement. No rendered-pixel/aesthetic claim.
limitations: Conservative AABBs can flag empty space around diagonal members. A positive flag needs rendered or triangle review; zero is a sufficient clearance result.
This checks geometry persistence and coordinate continuity, not text occlusion, labels, material opacity, aesthetics, or audible timing.
Step thresholds are review gates; smoothness still requires motion playback.
